name: panel
description: AI-simulated expert review lifecycle for research papers. Drives papers through 8 stages from draft to acceptance via structured reviewer panels.

commands.name: panel:go
commands.description: The one command — moves paper through all 8 lifecycle stages

commands.name: panel:status
commands.description: Overview of all papers: current stage, round, score, next action

commands.name: panel:show
commands.description: Detailed view of one paper — reviews, synthesis, score history, stage timeline

commands.name: panel:reviewers
commands.description: Browse, search, filter reviewer database by category/venue/expertise

commands.name: panel:setup
commands.description: Initialize panel in a project — create directory structure, copy reviewer database

commands.name: panel:import
commands.description: Discover and generate papers from roadmap/waves/commits, or import existing review artifacts

commands.name: panel:report
commands.description: Generate review reports — per-paper, per-round, portfolio-level

commands.name: panel:help
commands.description: Interactive help system with topics (stages, reviewers, scoring, workflow)

commands.name: panel:venue
commands.description: Venue recommendation + submission strategy based on review scores
